title: TEND solver-side allow-list disclosure
description: Release/baseline disclosure and archival Proposal 06 boundary manifest. The baseline runtime reads this file for disjointness and boundary disclosure; the repaired SMART-EG runtime does not load it as live tool or policy configuration. Prefix-execution entries below describe an unsupported archival design, not a production success mechanism.

runtime_status.note: Current SMART-EG tool exposure and final execution gates are implemented in src/tend/solver/eg/, not configured by this JSON file.

disabled_operator_note: Five disabled operators ($sample, $rand, $out, $merge, $function) plus one disabled system variable ($$NOW); AST filter must reject all six tokens.
train_json_access: forbidden:** (solver does not use train.json — neither training labels nor retrieval corpus, §06-2-0; NoSQL-native idioms come from frozen LLM knowledge + 06 §06-2-3 strategy table)

witness_sample_limit.note: ≤ K docs/collection may enter prompt-visible witness digests. The archival Proposal 06 design mentioned bounded prefix execution, but the repaired SMART-EG runtime does not implement that pipeline; final sanity execution is the supported runtime check.

sets.C_construction_pool: Construction Agent LLM model IDs used by {QPS, MS, MUT, PV, NLP, RTV, NNC, RA}

four_party_disjointness.s_solver_scope_note: A single shared LLM backbone runs all 4 stages (perception mode for ①, cognition mode for ②③④). Per-stage execution-guided decoding, AST filter and deterministic reduce use NO model — not counted. ① perception probes MAY optionally run on a same-family small model (cost optimization); if so, that model is counted in S_solver.

frozen_panel_note: frozen_panels.* is the release-pinned 4-panel manifest used for solver/baseline disjointness disclosure; non-stub baseline disclosure reports missing or empty required panels as disjointness failures.

shape_comprehension.owner_agent: LLM Agent · perception mode (concurrent map-reduce probes; may use a same-family small model when cost-sensitive)
shape_comprehension.note: __variants is the authoritative shape contract; no data sampling here. Undeclared real-data shapes are caught downstream via the query_realization → shape_comprehension loop.

mongo_executor.description: Archival Proposal 06 prefix-execution design. Current SMART-EG runtime does not implement prefix-pipeline execution tools; if such tools are exposed they return TOOL_UNIMPLEMENTED, and the no-prefix ablation hides them with tool_not_exposed. Production completion is through final sanity execution plus submit_final_mql.

mongo_executor.on_checkpoint_hit: locate by stage_index, then route via query_realization.feedback_routing to {heterogeneity_planning|intent_formalization|shape_comprehension}
mongo_executor.execution_scope: unsupported in repaired SMART-EG runtime; retained for release/baseline disclosure and archival boundary review, never evaluator gold
